config.notes: PlantDoc Core in-domain training. class_weighting=inverse_frequency is a documented dataset exception: PlantDoc Core train is imbalanced 90:1 (Corn leaf blight 180 images vs the arthropod-pest class at 2). A balanced sampler would oversample that 2-image class ~90x and overfit it, so the gentler class-weighted loss is used instead.
